name: The Verve

whyMatters.en: Wigan band formed in 1990. Urban Hymns (1997) put string loops, Nick McCabe’s guitar wash, and Richard Ashcroft’s baritone on late-Britpop chart scale; Bitter Sweet Symphony is the key single and a well-known sampling-rights case.
whyMatters.zh: 威根乐队，1990 年成立。《Urban Hymns》（1997）把弦乐循环、Nick McCabe 吉他铺底与 Richard Ashcroft 男中音推上晚期 Britpop 榜单体量；《Bitter Sweet Symphony》是关键单曲，也是知名采样版权案例。

lyricQuotes: Cause it's a bittersweet symphony, this life
The drugs don't work / They just make you worse

shortBio.en: Ashcroft / McCabe psych-Britpop. Urban Hymns is the 1997 peak; Bitter Sweet Symphony is the sample-era hit.
shortBio.zh: Ashcroft / McCabe 迷幻 Britpop。《Urban Hymns》是 1997 巅峰；《Bitter Sweet Symphony》是采样时代热单。

body.en:
The Verve formed in Wigan in 1990. A Storm in Heaven (1993) and A Northern Soul (1995) built long space-rock forms with McCabe’s tremolo wash. After a split and reunion, Urban Hymns (1997) used orchestral samples, mid-tempo arrangements, and Ashcroft’s baritone up front.

Bitter Sweet Symphony (1997) is the essential track and an ABKCO sampling dispute document. The Drugs Don't Work reached UK #1; Lucky Man followed as another Urban Hymns single. Hut Records released the peak albums.

Ashcroft and Simon Jones are from Wigan. With Nick McCabe and Peter Salisbury they started in 1989 at Winstanley College and signed to Hut, as Verve, in 1991. A Storm in Heaven (1993) was produced by John Leckie, who had produced The Stone Roses’ debut. They played Glastonbury 1993 and dates with Oasis. A 1994 fight with Verve Records forced the “The”. Lollapalooza 1994 is the US live node. A Northern Soul (1995) reached UK #13. Ashcroft broke the band up that summer, then restarted it with Simon Tong in McCabe’s chair. Tong and McCabe both play on Urban Hymns (1997).

Bitter Sweet Symphony uses The Andrew Oldham Orchestra’s version of The Rolling Stones’ The Last Time. After the plagiarism claim, royalties went to Jagger and Richards. Ashcroft, Chinese-edition wording, called it the best song Jagger and Richards had written in twenty years. The Drugs Don’t Work entered the UK chart at #1 on 7 September 1997. Noel Gallagher had already dedicated Morning Glory’s Cast No Shadow to Ashcroft. A 1998 home show at Haigh Hall drew about 33,000. McCabe left in 1998; B.J. Cole played pedal steel. The band ended in 1999. Tong later replaced Coxon on Blur’s Think Tank tour and played in The Good, the Bad & the Queen with Albarn. The original four sold out a 2007 return in about twenty minutes. Forth (2008) was another UK #1. They stopped again in August 2009.
body.zh:
The Verve 于 1990 年在威根成立。《A Storm in Heaven》（1993）与《A Northern Soul》（1995）以 McCabe tremolo 铺底建立长篇 space-rock。分裂/重组后推出《Urban Hymns》（1997）——管弦采样、中速编曲、Ashcroft 男中音前置。

《Bitter Sweet Symphony》（1997）是必听曲目，也是 ABKCO 采样纠纷文献。《The Drugs Don't Work》登上英国榜冠军；《Lucky Man》同为《Urban Hymns》单曲。巅峰专辑由 Hut Records 发行。

Ashcroft 与 Simon Jones 来自威根。他们和 Nick McCabe、Peter Salisbury 1989 年在温斯坦利学院开始，1991 年以 Verve 的名字签给 Hut。《A Storm in Heaven》（1993）的制作人是 John Leckie，他做过 The Stone Roses 的首张专辑。1993 年他们上了格拉斯顿伯里，并与 Oasis 同台。1994 年与 Verve Records 的官司之后，名字加上 The。1994 年 Lollapalooza 是美国现场节点。《A Northern Soul》（1995）英国榜第 13。Ashcroft 那年夏天解散乐队，随即以 Simon Tong 接 McCabe 重组。Tong 与 McCabe 都参加了《Urban Hymns》（1997）。

《Bitter Sweet Symphony》用了 The Andrew Oldham Orchestra 演奏的 Rolling Stones《The Last Time》。剽窃指控之后，版税交给 Jagger 与 Richards。中文版所引 Ashcroft：这是 Jagger 和 Richards 二十年来写得最好的歌。《The Drugs Don’t Work》1997 年 9 月 7 日首次上榜即英国冠军。Noel Gallagher 此前已把《Morning Glory》里的《Cast No Shadow》献给 Ashcroft。1998 年海伊霍尔家乡演出约 3.3 万人。McCabe 1998 年离开，B.J. Cole 弹踏板钢棒吉他。乐队 1999 年结束。Tong 后来在 Blur 的 Think Tank 巡演接替 Coxon，并与 Albarn 在 The Good, the Bad & the Queen 里演奏。原始四人 2007 年回归演出约 20 分钟售罄。《Forth》（2008）又是英国冠军。2009 年 8 月再次停止。

note.zh: 《A Storm in Heaven》时期曲目；McCabe tremolo 铺底、长篇 space rock。

title.zh: 从 space rock 到 Urban Hymns

body.en:
Early catalog runs long—Slide Away and A Northern Soul tracks with McCabe’s wet guitar. Urban Hymns compresses similar melancholy into radio length with string loops and piano ballads.

Bitter Sweet Symphony’s Oldham sample is both a production fact and a legal footnote.
body.zh:
早期目录偏长——《Slide Away》与《A Northern Soul》曲目配 McCabe 湿吉他。《Urban Hymns》把相近的忧郁压进电台长度，加弦乐循环与钢琴抒情。

《Bitter Sweet Symphony》的 Oldham 采样既是制作事实，也是法律脚注。

title.en: McCabe exit and Urban Hymns reunion
title.zh: McCabe 离队与 Urban Hymns 重组

body.en:
Classic four: Ashcroft vocal, McCabe guitar wash, Jones bass, Salisbury drums. McCabe leaves in 1995; returns for Urban Hymns after an Ashcroft/Jones/Salisbury gap. Simon Tong joins guitar/keys on the peak five-piece.

The 2007 reunion restores the four names. They stop again in August 2009.

Leckie links the first album to The Stone Roses. Tong is the shared guitarist with Blur. The Stones sample on Bitter Sweet Symphony is the publishing node.
body.zh:
经典四人：Ashcroft 人声、McCabe 吉他铺底、Jones 贝斯、Salisbury 鼓。McCabe 于 1995 年离队；Ashcroft/Jones/Salisbury 空窗后为《Urban Hymns》回归。Simon Tong 在巅峰五人组中加入吉他/键盘。

2007 年重聚恢复四人名。2009 年 8 月再次停止。

Leckie 把第一张专辑和 The Stone Roses 连在一起。Tong 是与 Blur 共用的吉他。Rolling Stones 采样是《Bitter Sweet Symphony》的版权节点。

alt.zh: Richard Ashcroft 现场，2006 年 7 月 9 日

title.en: Late Britpop and later ballad writing
title.zh: 晚期 Britpop 与后来的抒情写法

body.en:
Urban Hymns marks Britpop’s 1997 commercial peak with mid-tempo strings and mortality lyrics, distinct from Oasis-style laddish anthems. Early Coldplay piano ballads are often compared to this Ashcroft/McCabe approach.

Bitter Sweet Symphony remains a sampling-rights case study beside its chart history.
body.zh:
《Urban Hymns》以中速弦乐与死亡主题歌词标记 Britpop 1997 商业高峰，有别于 Oasis 式兄弟会颂歌。Coldplay 早期钢琴抒情常被拿来与这套 Ashcroft/McCabe 写法对照。

《Bitter Sweet Symphony》在榜单史之外，仍是采样版权案例。
